adaptive_composition.statement: DKTAdaptive.badRuns_probability: for an arbitrary history-dependent family bad : List F -> Finset F with |bad hist| <= E hist.length, the probability that a uniform length-n challenge vector has some draw bad at its own history is <= budgetSum E hist.length n / |F|.
adaptive_composition.conditioning: explicit: bad takes the whole preceding challenge history, so an adversary may choose each committed word as any function of the earlier challenges
adaptive_composition.model: classical finite sampling; not Fiat-Shamir/QROM; assumes sample_ext is uniform on Ext12

ordered_coset.concrete_generators_proved: p = 2013265921, GENERATOR = 31 has order p-1; 31^((p-1)/15) = 1995471372 has order 15; omega^h = -1 for order-2h elements
ordered_coset.index_arithmetic_proved: index = a*h + u is i/h and i%h; roots are exactly cosetMajorSquareDomain's
ordered_coset.open_statement: the compiled Rust evaluates these expressions on the same integer representatives with the same Fin layout and hash_coset leaf order; that is a program-refinement statement, not a ring identity
